text:
Avery: quick alert — canary attestation failing after RBAC tidy. cosign signing error: "permission denied: cloudkms.cryptoKeys.sign"
Rohit: confirmed. PR #912 removed a wildcard binding and accidentally stripped cosign SA.
Nina: which key resource? we need the full name to check IAM bindings and audit logs.
Avery: projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/signer/cryptoKeys/cosign-key
Tess: we should avoid broad re-adds. propose: 1) temp route canary to ephemeral signer key 2) re-add binding with IAM condition (infra CIDR + workflow header) 3) ensure audit sink captures cloudkms events before re-grant
ci-bot: SCAN: base-minimal:sha256:dd44 - ATTEST_FAIL - cosign: signing failed (permission denied). https://ci.internal/scan/dd44
Rohit: creating OPS ticket OPS-4999 to request `roles/cloudkms.signerVerifier` for serviceAccount:cosign-svc@redwood-prod with condition. tagging @Oncall for window.
Oncall: can schedule additive binding in maintenance window 01:30 UTC. Note: if key is re-enabled or binding changed, record it in the key rotation log and trigger audit-export verification.
Avery: temporary mitigation: Tess, can your helm patch route pods with label `attest=canary` to `cosign-ephemeral-2026`?
Tess: yep, pushing patch to canary lineage now. will set DEPLOY_HOLD until we verify ephemeral attestation.
Nina: I'll check audit sink health. Last 24h delivery shows gap 3h ago to BigQuery writer SA. Opening OPS-5000 to restore sink perms.
Rohit: created PR #921 to re-add binding with condition and a terraform plan guard that fails if signer bindings are removed from known keys.
Avery: also open SEC ticket for vuln scan noise — CVE-2026-3301 showed up in base packages as low risk; track but proceed with signer fix first.
ci-bot: ACTION: DEPLOY_HOLD set for canary/base-minimal until attestation smoke passes.
Oncall: OPS-4999 accepted, applying binding during 01:30 UTC window. If audit sink still down, apply binding but document timeline; follow-up to repair sink required.
Tess: ephemeral signer smoke passed locally, CI verify queued. will post results here.
Nina: audit sink perms restored (OPS-5000 done). BigQuery sink writer regained roles/bigquery.dataEditor. Backfilling events scheduled.
Rohit: binding applied in window, smoke CI shows attestation success. removing DEPLOY_HOLD, proceed with canary rollout.
Avery: thanks team. follow-ups: (a) add iam-test in CI to check cosign bindings on PRs touching RBAC (b) add runbook step: route to ephemeral signer + check audit sink before re-grant (c) close SEC ticket if vuln confirmed low. Closing thread after CI green. :white_check_mark:
